about: Functions that only send headers. PHP keeps no header list under the CLI, so an api probe cannot compare them; each is proven instead by a check in an HTTP suite that compares the engine's response with the reference's (Austin, D9, 2026-10-11). compat-status counts a function here as verified when it is real and its suite holds the check, label for label.

rest_handle_deprecated_function.check: a REST request reports a deprecated function and its replacement as the reference does

rest_handle_deprecated_argument.check: a REST request reports a deprecated argument and its message as the reference does

rest_handle_doing_it_wrong.check: a REST request reports a call made incorrectly, with its version, as the reference does
